expectations: Reuses or audits the existing tested helper, preserves explicit repo/login and HTTP status checking, and normalizes nullable collections before iteration.

Keeps full responses/briefs in files, parses complete JSON outside the truncating reader, stores only small IDs/paths/status in orchestration memory, and reconciles issue900 before any possible retry rather than recreating it.
